title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00107 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 07:30: POOH w/ 9 5/8 CSG from 1290 m to 3 0m. Pulling average 12,7 joints/h, maximum 15 joints/h
07:30 - 07:45: Performed weekly fire drill. Kick drill 42 sec to secure the well.
07:45 - 08:00: Pulled from 30m to surface the remaining joints. No fish observed on the last joint
08:00 - 08:15: Performed pre-job meeting for rigging down CSG pulling equipment
08:15 - 10:15: R/d CSG pulling equipment
10:15 - 10:45: Cleaned rig floor
10:45 - 11:00: Performed pre-job meeting before p/u 13 3/8 EZSV plug
11:00 - 11:45: P/u and m/u the EZSV running tool, installed EZSV plug and loaded centralizer springs
11:45 - 12:00: Changed master bushing to ps21
12:00 - 17:00: RIH w/ EZSV BHA from surface to 2338 2min/std
17:00 - 17:30: Took parameters PU weight 144t,so weight 130t. Broke circulation 800lpm, 9,2 bar. Washed setting area between 2337m to 2343m
17:30 - 18:00: Set EZSV plug 2340m. 10rpm, 37 CW turns, p/u to 154t, held. P/u to 164t, held. Pin sheared 28t overpull
18:00 - 19:00: P/u to 2337m, circulated 2600lpm, 38bar. Increased in steps to 3500lpm, 60bar. H2s on shaker 103ppm in mud and 2ppm in air. Meanwhile m/u pump-in sub assembly for cement job
19:00 - 21:00: Continued to circulate 2 bu 3500lpm, 65bar, 30rpm, 2-5knm. Circulated until h2s level is down to 0. Meanwhile performed TBT for cementing operation and pressure tested cement line to 100bar
21:00 - 21:30: R/b stand, p/u pumping sub assembly, m/u TDS
21:30 - 22:00: Installed cementing hose, lined up cementing line. Pressure tested connection between pumping sub and LTV. Observed leak on LTV.
22:00 - 22:15: Changed out LTV, re-tested cementing line up to 100bar. Good test
